admission.capacityNote: No numerus fixus statement, no capacity and no selection procedure were found on Twente's pages for this programme.

requirements.label: A full IB Diploma

officialWording.text: A successfully completed International Baccalaureate diploma is required before the start of the academic year. In general, there is no minimum IB grade requirement.

requirements.note: No minimum total is published. Twente states that the IB Career-related Certificate is not directly admissible, though it invites a case-by-case application from anyone holding a further qualification alongside it. On Course Results specifically, Twente says only that IB certificates may be admitted "in combination with another high school diploma", which is a student who already holds a qualifying school-leaving qualification — not a Course candidate holding IB subjects and nothing else. Twente also states the general rule that "a certificate or diploma must be awarded upon completion".
requirements.alternativeRoute: It does not close this one to you, and Twente publishes the alternative in more detail than any other Dutch institution here. Twente names IB certificates once, and only "in combination with another high school diploma", so Course Results standing alone are not directly admissible. What it publishes instead is the Colloquium Doctum (toelatingsonderzoek), which it runs under articles 7.25, 7.28 and 7.29 of the Dutch Higher Education Act. You must be at least 21 on 1 September of the year you start. Applications open on 1 October through Studielink like anybody else's: you file a normal enrolment request before the programme's deadline, then complete the Osiris questionnaire, upload whatever diplomas you do hold and a blank PDF stating that you are applying via a full Colloquium Doctum. You then have to pass the VWO-level subjects Twente lists for this programme — VWO English and VWO Mathematics A, B or C — with certificates from CCVX, James Boswell or the Dutch Official State Examination, all before that programme's deadline. There is no blanket Dutch-language requirement: VWO Dutch appears in Twente's table only against its Dutch-taught programmes, and not against this one. Twente also publishes two slower routes: an hbo propedeuse, the first 60 ECTS of a bachelor at a Dutch university of applied sciences, NVAO-accredited and relevant to the programme, which it says does not guarantee admission; and a foundation year, accepted only where the resulting qualification is nationally accredited in the country it was taken in, assessed case by case. All of these wait for your 21st birthday. Retaking to be awarded the full IB Diploma is the route that reaches this at eighteen. One further route is national rather than this institution's, and it is the only one that produces the qualification itself instead of an exemption from it: the Dutch staatsexamen vwo. Anyone who registers may sit vwo subjects one at a time with DUO — registration for the 2027 examinations runs from 15 October to 31 December 2026, each subject costs 144 euro with a ceiling of 720 euro a year, and the certificates stay valid for ten years, so the package can be built up and exchanged for a vwo diploma at the end. No age limit applies, which is what makes it different from every colloquium doctum above, and Dutch law lets the College voor Toetsen en Examens grant you ontheffing from individual subjects on the strength of International Baccalaureate results — the one place in Dutch education law where the IB is named. The bill is linguistic: by statute the examinations are sat in Dutch.

requirements.label: One of four IB English routes, or an English test

officialWording.text: English Language A: Literature – Standard Level or Higher Level - Grade ≥ 4; English Language A: Language and Literature – Standard Level or Higher Level - Grade ≥ 4; English Language B – Standard Level - Grade ≥ 6; English Language B – Higher Level - Grade ≥ 5

requirements.note: Twente is the only institution in this catalogue that publishes its English rule as IB subjects with IB grades rather than as a test score with an exemption, so it is recorded as a subject rule and the engine checks it directly. There is also a separate exemption: if your Diploma programme was taught in English and you took one of the listed English subjects, no test is needed. The SL alternatives are satisfied by HL too, because the engine compares levels rather than matching them.

officialRequirementsText.text: You are admissible if you have an international secondary school diploma equivalent to the Dutch VWO-diploma: good A-level results or International Baccalaureate. As the programme is entirely English-taught, you have to meet the English language requirement.

notes: Twente publishes each intake's admission requirements only from the October before it and says in terms that it cannot give information about a future intake. Everything on this record is the September 2026 rule and should be re-read after October 2026. It is marked needs-review for that reason rather than presented as settled.

Twente's own deadline for the 2026 intake was 30 April 23:59 CET, a day before the national one. The 2027 date was not published when this was checked. Work to 1 May 2027 as the outer limit and expect Twente to set something earlier.

No subject requirement is recorded because Twente publishes none. The International diploma panel on the admission page was opened and read on 2026-09-23 and names no subject, where the Advanced Technology panel on the same site names two. This is checked-and-absent, not unchecked — but it means the diploma is the bar, not that a place is assured.
For an IB student who wants to build things and did not take HL sciences, this is one of very few routes into a technical university anywhere in this catalogue.
